data.text:
The Bridge, Skyline, Sky Tree, PNN, Marry Time, Mien Roub Mkodi, February 4

Authorities searched — but did not find scam operations in — six buildings across Phnom Penh: The Bridge in Chamkarmon; The Skyline near O’Russei Market; Sky Tree Residence and Hotel in Russei Keo district; the “PNN” building in Chroy Changva district, possibly referring to the TV station on Ly Yongphat Street; the “Marry Time” building in Meanchey district; and the “Mien Roub Mkodi” building in Daun Penh district. References to the last two could not be found. (Kampuchea Thmey)

February 3-18

Phnom Penh authorities announced they had raided 40 online scam sites out of more than 2,700 suspected sites, including condominiums, apartments, borey gated housing, guesthouses and hotels. Some 284 foreign nationals, from Bangladesh, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan, Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan and Vietnam, were removed. One Cambodia, one Singaporean and 22 Chinese nationals were suspected of being ringleaders. (Kampuchea Thmey)

Prince Group, Koh Pich, January 28

A notice on Prince Group headquarters on Koh Pich dated January 28 said evidence was seized and the location was closed down on order of investigating judge Sam Veasna.

January 27

A deputy traffic chief for the Sen Sok district police was questioned over allegedly illegally taking $160,000 to process documents for 10 Taiwanese nationals. (Kampuchea Thmey)

https://t.co/lNTqWD1y7D

January 27

A first Chinese suspect was arrested in Preah Sihanouk province over the shooting of a woman in Phnom Penh’s Chamkar Mon district. (Kampuchea Thmey)

"Hindi po ito masasabing walang krimen. The mere fact na sinabi niya ito in public, to the public, pertaining to a particular person. It is already covered by Safe Spaces Act," Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said as she rebuked remarks made by a lawmaker that drew fierce backlash, warning that publicly expressed “fantasies” about women may constitute sexual harassment under the law.

Republic Act 11313 or the Safe Spaces Act penalizes gender-based sexual harassment in streets, public spaces, workplaces and online platforms.

Quezon City 4th District Rep. Bong Suntay has come under fire for saying during Tuesday’s hearing of the House justice committee on the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte that he felt “desires” after seeing actress Anne Curtis in person.

𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐲 – 𝐃𝐡𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐣𝐢

In view of the visit of Hon’ble Chief Minister Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma to Dhemaji on 𝟓 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐡 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 for the 𝐉𝐚𝐧𝐚 𝐀𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐫𝐛𝐚𝐝 𝐘𝐚𝐭𝐫𝐚, traffic diversions and parking arrangements have been put in place by the Dhemaji Police for smooth conduct of the programme.

Vehicles coming from Jonai/Silapathar side towards Dhemaji, Gogamukh and Lakhimpur are advised to follow the Kulajan Tiniali route from 8:00 AM, while certain stretches of the National Highway towards Gogamukh will remain restricted during specific hours. Vehicles from Gogamukh side travelling towards Dhemaji, Jonai and Silapathar are requested to use the Dhakuakhana route during the regulated period.

Participants attending the programme are requested to park their vehicles only at the designated parking areas including IDBT Telijan, DRDA campus, Dhemaji Court Field, Dhemaji College Field, Old Bus Stand and Rongsojia Pathar.

Ambulances and emergency vehicles will remain exempted. Vehicles travelling towards Guwahati from Jonai/Silapathar/Dibrugarh are advised to use the Sivasagar–Jorhat route.

All citizens are requested to cooperate with the administration and follow the advisory for smooth traffic management.
